column23: "The  intervention  included  five  SC educational  sessions  held  weekly  for  five consecutive weeks. The length of each session ranged from 45 to 60 minutes. All sessions wereheld by the first author. The educational package had already been developed by Reyhani et al.32It includes topics such as reliance on God, seekinghelp from holy people, patience, generosity, altruism, mantra, and prayer.
